questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.topic: Purpose in an opening the writer composed
questions.learningObjective: Identify the purpose in the graph's opening label

stimulus.body: The bar chart displays values for six months. Values rise steadily from January to June. No other variable is shown.

questions.stem: A report on purpose in an opening the writer composed notes that two passages on one theme can be compared through their graphs.

options.text: The graph's main idea is a steady increase across the observed period of time.
options.misconception: treats a temporary rise as the overall trend of the data

options.text: The graph's main idea is a sharp decline after the midpoint of the series.
options.misconception: confuses a local dip with the global direction of the series

options.text: The graph's main idea is stability with only minor fluctuations overall.
The graph's main idea is a repeating cyclical pattern across the years.
options.misconception: projects a repeating cycle without evidence in the data

questions.explanation: The correct option names the claim the graph actually supports, while the distractors either overstate a local feature or invent a pattern the data do not show.
questions.hint: Look for the claim the whole graph supports.
